goals.title: Find prematch flag texture source
goals.description: Verified original PS1 SELECT code uploads both 64×28 prematch flags as one 64×56 4bpp rectangle to VRAM (560,0), using RAM 0x800CC600 (left, 896 bytes) and 0x800CC980 (right, 896 bytes). Upload paths 0x80092F38 and 0x8009310C. Investigate the preceding buffer writer using matched screen, GPU and MIPS trace evidence; palette or VRAM equality alone does not prove which disc resource supplied the pixels.

goals.title: Trace the carried ceremonial banner
goals.description: Capture the banner carried by players and its possible GPU upload. Compare with original stadium GDC resources and other prematch captures.

goals.title: Track crowd flag reloads
goals.description: Collect audience flag captures and investigate whether stadium graphics uploads overwrite previously loaded country-flag textures.

goals.title: Locate small scoreboard flags
goals.description: Capture match HUD flag candidates for Bosnia, Canada and New Zealand, then correlate their palette and sprite placement using locally retained evidence.
